readerCopy.body: A sudden break can release something you have been repeating for much longer than you realized. Uranus conjunct the South Node can disrupt an old routine, role, alliance, or way of staying predictable because it once kept life manageable. The change may arrive faster than your explanation for it. Something that felt permanent can suddenly look optional. Do not rush to rebuild the exact arrangement just because the empty space feels strange. The disruption may be showing you how much of the pattern was habit.
